    <div style="text-align: center; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">TAX MATTERS AGREEMENT</div>
    <div style="text-align: center; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"> <br>
    </div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt; font-size: 12pt;"><font style="font-size: 10pt; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">This TAX MATTERS AGREEMENT (this &#8220;<u>Agreement</u>&#8221;), is entered into as of </font><font style="font-size: 10pt;">[&#9679;], 20[&#9679;] <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">between KBR, Inc., a Delaware corporation (the &#8220;<u>Company</u>&#8221;), and Trinzic, Inc., a Delaware corporation and wholly owned subsidiary of the Company (&#8220;<u>SpinCo</u>&#8221; and, together with the Company, the &#8220;<u>Parties</u>,&#8221; and each,
          a &#8220;<u>Party</u>&#8221;). Capitalized terms used in this Agreement and not defined herein shall have the meanings ascribed to such terms in the Separation and Distribution Agreement, dated as of </font>[&#9679;], 20[&#9679;]<font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">,
          between the Parties (the &#8220;<u>Separation Agreement</u>&#8221;).</font></font></div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-align: center; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">R E C I T A L S</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 18pt;">WHEREAS, the Company, acting through its direct and indirect Subsidiaries, currently conducts the Parent Retained Business and the SpinCo Business;</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 18pt;">WHEREAS, the Board of Directors of the Company (the &#8220;<u>Company Board</u>&#8221;) has determined that it is appropriate, desirable and in the best interests of the Company and its stockholders to separate (a) the Parent
      Retained Business, which shall be owned and conducted, directly or indirectly, by the Company and its Subsidiaries (other than SpinCo and its Subsidiaries) and (b) the SpinCo Business, which shall be owned and conducted, directly or indirectly, by
      SpinCo and its Subsidiaries;</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 18pt;">WHEREAS, pursuant to the Internal Reorganization, KBR Holdings, a direct, wholly owned subsidiary of the Company that is classified as a corporation for U.S. federal income Tax purposes, will effect the Internal
      Contribution in exchange for equity interests of Internal SpinCo, Internal SpinCo&#8217;s assumption of the obligations associated with certain intercompany payables, and an aggregate amount of cash equal to the Distributed Internal SpinCo Borrowing
      Proceeds;</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 18pt;">WHEREAS, following the Internal Contribution, and pursuant to the Internal Reorganization, KBR Holdings will effect the Internal SpinCo Distribution;</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 18pt;">WHEREAS, in connection with the Internal Spin-Off, KBR Holdings will use the Distributed Internal SpinCo Borrowing Proceeds to make the Internal Cash Distribution, which will be used to repay historical debt of the
      Company;</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 18pt;">WHEREAS, following the Internal Spin-Off, and pursuant to the Internal Reorganization, the Company will effect the Contribution and, in connection therewith, will contribute all of the issued and outstanding equity
      interests of Internal SpinCo and the stock of Solutions Insurance Company to SpinCo in exchange for the Consideration;</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 18pt;">WHEREAS, following the completion of the Internal Reorganization and the Contribution, the Company shall effect the Distribution on the terms and conditions set forth in the Separation Agreement;</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="clear: both; margin-top: 10pt; margin-bottom: 10pt;" class="BRPFPageBreakArea">
      <div style="text-align: center;" class="BRPFPageNumberArea"><font style="font-size: 8pt; color: #000000; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal;" class="BRPFPageNumber">1</font></div>
      <div style="page-break-after: always;" class="BRPFPageBreak">
        <hr style="border-width: 0px; clear: both; margin: 4px 0px; width: 100%; height: 2px; color: #000000; background-color: #000000;" noshade="noshade"></div>
    </div>
    <div style="text-indent: 18pt;">WHEREAS, it is the intention of the Parties that, for U.S. federal income Tax purposes: (a) the Internal Contribution and the Internal SpinCo Distribution, taken together, qualify as a &#8220;reorganization&#8221; under Sections
      368(a)(1)(D) and 355(a) of the Code, (b) the Contribution and Distribution, taken together, qualify as a &#8220;reorganization&#8221; within the meaning of Sections 368(a)(1)(D) and 355(a) of the Code, and (c) the Separation Agreement constitutes a &#8220;plan of
      reorganization&#8221; for purposes of Section 368 of the Code and within the meaning of Treas. Reg. Section 1.368-2(g) for each of the Internal Contribution and Internal SpinCo Distribution (taken together) and the Contribution and Distribution (taken
      together), and for purposes of Sections 354, 361 and 368 of the Code<font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">;</font></div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">WHEREAS, the Company is the common parent of an affiliated group of domestic corporations, including SpinCo, that has elected to file consolidated U.S. federal income Tax Returns and, as a result of
      the Distribution, neither SpinCo nor any of its Affiliates will be a member of such group after the close of the Distribution Date;</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">WHEREAS, certain members of the Company Group, on the one hand, and certain members of the SpinCo Group, on the other hand, file certain Tax Returns on a consolidated, combined, unitary or similar
      basis for certain federal, state, local and foreign Tax purposes; and</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">WHEREAS, the Parties desire to (a) provide for the payment of Tax liabilities and entitlement to refunds thereof, allocate responsibility for, and cooperation in, the filing of Tax Returns, and
      provide for certain other matters relating to Taxes, and (b) set forth certain covenants and indemnities relating to the preservation of the Tax-Free Status.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual agreements, provisions and covenants contained in this Agreement, and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which
      are hereby acknowledged, the Parties, intending to be legally bound, hereby agree as follows:</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-align: center; font-weight: bold;"><a name="z_Toc225759001"></a>ARTICLE I</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-align: center; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-weight: bold;"><a name="z_Toc225759076"></a><a name="z_Toc239862214"></a><a name="z_Toc225759151"></a>DEFINITIONS</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt;"><a name="z_Toc225759152"></a><a name="z_Toc239862215"></a><a name="z_Toc225759002"></a><a name="z_Toc225759077"></a>1.1&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;<u>General</u>.&#160; As used in this Agreement, the following terms shall have the following
      meanings:</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#8220;<u>Accounting Firm</u>&#8221; shall have the meaning set forth in <u>Section 9.1</u>.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#8220;<u>Adjustment</u>&#8221; shall mean an adjustment of any item of income, gain, loss, deduction, credit or any other item affecting Taxes of a taxpayer pursuant to a Final Determination.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#8220;<u>Affiliate</u>&#8221; shall mean, with respect to a Person, any other Person that directly or indirectly, through one or more intermediaries, controls, is controlled by, or is under common control with,
      the specified Person. For this purpose, &#8220;control&#8221; of a Person means the possession, directly or indirectly, of the power to direct or cause the direction of the management or policies of such Person, whether through ownership of voting securities, by
      contract or otherwise. The term &#8220;Affiliate&#8221; shall refer to Affiliates of a Person as determined immediately after the Distribution.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#8220;<u>Agreement</u>&#8221; shall have the meaning set forth in the preamble hereto.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="clear: both; margin-top: 10pt; margin-bottom: 10pt;" class="BRPFPageBreakArea">
      <div style="text-align: center;" class="BRPFPageNumberArea"><font style="font-size: 8pt; color: #000000; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal;" class="BRPFPageNumber">2</font></div>
      <div style="page-break-after: always;" class="BRPFPageBreak">
        <hr style="border-width: 0px; clear: both; margin: 4px 0px; width: 100%; height: 2px; color: #000000; background-color: #000000;" noshade="noshade"></div>
    </div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#8220;<u>Capital Stock</u>&#8221; shall mean all classes or series of capital stock, including (i) common stock, (ii) all options, warrants and other rights to acquire such capital stock and (iii) all
      instruments properly treated as stock for U.S. federal income Tax purposes.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#8220;<u>Code</u>&#8221; shall mean the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#8220;<u>Company</u>&#8221; shall have the meaning set forth in the preamble hereto.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#8220;<u>Company Affiliated Group</u>&#8221; shall mean an affiliated group (as that term is defined in Section 1504 of the Code and the regulations thereunder) of which the Company is the common parent (as
      that term is defined in Section 1504 of the Code and the regulations thereunder).</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt; font-size: 12pt;"><font style="font-size: 10pt; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#8220;<u>Company Consolidated Tax Return</u>&#8221; shall mean any U.S. federal consolidated income Tax Return for a Company Affiliated Group </font><font style="font-size: 10pt;">and any consolidated, combined, unitary or similar income Tax Return required to be filed by the Company or a member of the Company Group as common parent (or analogous concept) under a similar or analogous provision of
        state, local or non-U.S. Law<font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">.</font></font></div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#8220;<u>Company Separate Return</u>&#8221; shall mean any Tax Return of or including any member of the Company Group (including any consolidated, combined, unitary or similar return) that is not a Joint
      Return.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt;">&#8220;<u>Company Transaction Tax Required Payment</u>&#8221; <font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">shall have the meaning set forth in <u>Section 2.9(b)(ii)</u>.</font></div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#8220;<u>Controlling Party</u>&#8221; shall mean, with respect to a Tax Contest, the Party entitled to control such Tax Contest pursuant to <u>Sections 6.2</u>, <u>6.3</u>, and <u>6.4</u> of this Agreement.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt; font-size: 12pt;"><font style="font-size: 10pt; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#8220;</font><font style="font-size: 10pt;"><u>Designated SpinCo Separate Return</u>&#8221; shall mean (i) any SpinCo Separate Return with respect to State Taxes
        for the taxable year ending on the Distribution Date, and (ii) any SpinCo Separate Return with respect to Foreign Taxes set forth on Exhibit C, in each case excluding any subsequent amendment of such Tax Return.</font></div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#8220;<u>Distribution Tax Opinions</u>&#8221; shall mean (i) the written opinion of Wilmer Cutler Pickering Hale and Dorr LLP, reasonably satisfactory in form and substance to the Company and dated as of the
      Distribution Date, regarding the &#8220;business purpose&#8221; requirement that will apply to the intended U.S. federal income Tax treatments of the Contribution and Distribution as set forth in clauses (a)(i) and (a)(iv) of the definition of Tax-Free Status,
      and (ii) a written opinion of Baker &amp; McKenzie LLP, reasonably satisfactory in form and substance to the Company and dated on or before the Distribution Date, regarding the &#8220;business purpose&#8221; requirement that will apply to the intended U.S.
      federal income Tax treatment of the Internal Spin-Off.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#8220;<u>Distribution Taxes</u>&#8221; shall mean any Taxes incurred as a result of the failure of any of the Transactions described in this Agreement in the definition of &#8220;Tax-Free Status&#8221; to qualify for such
      Tax-Free Status.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#8220;<u>Distribution-Related Tax Contest</u>&#8221; shall mean any Tax Contest in which the IRS, another Taxing Authority, or any other Person asserts a position that could reasonably be expected to (i)
      adversely affect, jeopardize or prevent the Tax-Free Status or (ii) otherwise affect the amount of Taxes imposed with respect to any of the Transactions.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="clear: both; margin-top: 10pt; margin-bottom: 10pt;" class="BRPFPageBreakArea">
      <div style="text-align: center;" class="BRPFPageNumberArea"><font style="font-size: 8pt; color: #000000; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal;" class="BRPFPageNumber">3</font></div>

    </div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#8220;<u>Employment Tax</u>&#8221; shall mean those Liabilities for Taxes which are allocable pursuant to the provisions of the Employee Matters Agreement.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#8220;<u>Extraordinary Transaction</u>&#8221; means any action that is not in the ordinary course of business, but shall not include any action expressly required by any Transaction Document (including the
      Separation Agreement) or any action undertaken pursuant to the Separation Plan or pursuant to, or prior to, the Contribution or the Distribution.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#8220;<u>Federal Tax</u>&#8221; means any Tax imposed by the federal government of the United States other than any Employment Tax.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#8220;<u>Fifty-Percent or Greater Interest</u>&#8221; has the meaning ascribed to such term for purposes of Sections 355(d) and (e) of the Code and the Treasury Regulations thereunder.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#8220;<u>Final Determination</u>&#8221; shall mean the final resolution of liability for any Tax for any taxable period, by or as a result of (i) IRS Form 870 or 870-AD (or any successor forms thereto), on the
      date of acceptance by or on behalf of the taxpayer, or by a comparable form under the Laws of a state, local or non-U.S. taxing jurisdiction, except that a Form 870 or 870-AD or comparable form shall not constitute a Final Determination to the extent
      that it reserves (whether by its terms or by operation of Law) the right of the taxpayer to file a claim for refund or the right of the Taxing Authority to assert a further deficiency in respect of such issue or adjustment or for such taxable period
      (as the case may be), (ii) a final decision, judgment, decree or other order by any court of competent jurisdiction that can no longer be appealed, (iii) a final settlement with the IRS, a closing agreement or accepted offer in compromise under
      Section 7121 or 7122 of the Code, or a comparable agreement under the Laws of other jurisdictions, (iv) any allowance of a refund or credit in respect of an overpayment of Tax, but only after the expiration of all periods during which such refund or
      credit may be recovered (including by way of offset) by the jurisdiction imposing the Tax, or (v) any other final resolution, including by reason of the expiration of the applicable statute of limitations or the execution of a mutual agreement with
      the IRS or other Taxing Authority.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#8220;<u>Foreign Tax</u>&#8221; shall mean any Tax imposed by any foreign country or any possession of the United States, or by any political subdivision of any foreign country or United States possession,
      other than any Pillar Two Tax.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#8220;<u>Group</u>&#8221; shall mean either the Company Group or the SpinCo Group, as the context requires.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#8220;<u>High-Level Tax Dispute</u>&#8221; shall mean any dispute or disagreement (i) relating to liability with respect to Distribution Taxes or (ii) in which the amount of liability in dispute exceeds $10
      million.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#8220;<u>Indemnifying Party</u>&#8221; shall have the meaning set forth in <u>Section 5.2(a)</u>.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#8220;<u>Indemnitee</u>&#8221; shall have the meaning set forth in <u>Section 5.2(a)</u>.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="clear: both; margin-top: 10pt; margin-bottom: 10pt;" class="BRPFPageBreakArea">
      <div style="text-align: center;" class="BRPFPageNumberArea"><font style="font-size: 8pt; color: #000000; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal;" class="BRPFPageNumber">4</font></div>

    </div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt; font-size: 12pt;"><font style="font-size: 10pt; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#8220;<u>Internal Distribution</u>&#8221; </font><font style="font-size: 10pt;">shall mean a distribution or exchange of stock of a Subsidiary of the Company
        (determined prior to the Distribution) and intended to qualify as a reorganization described in Sections 368(a)(1)(D) and 355(a) of the Code (including, for the avoidance of doubt, the Internal Spin-Off).</font></div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#8220;<u>Internal Restructuring</u>&#8221; means (i) any action or series of actions undertaken in connection with an internal restructuring (whether effected by making or revoking any election under Treasury
      Regulations Section 301.7701-3 with respect to one or more entities or otherwise) involving SpinCo and/or any of its Subsidiaries or (ii) any direct or indirect contribution, sale or other transfer by or among any of SpinCo and any of its
      Subsidiaries of any of the assets contributed or transferred to SpinCo or any of its subsidiaries as part of the Contribution or otherwise pursuant to the Separation Agreement or any of the Transaction Documents.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#8220;<u>IRS</u>&#8221; shall mean the United States Internal Revenue Service or any successor thereto, including, but not limited to its agents, representatives, and attorneys.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#8220;<u>IRS Ruling</u>&#8221; shall mean any U.S. federal income Tax ruling, and any supplements thereto, issued to the Company by the IRS in connection with the Transactions.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt; font-size: 12pt;"><font style="font-size: 10pt; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#8220;<u>IRS Ruling Request</u>&#8221; shall mean the letter filed by the Company with the IRS on </font><font style="font-size: 10pt;">June 10, 2026<font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"> (including all attachments, exhibits, and other materials submitted with such letter) requesting a ruling regarding certain tax consequences of the Transactions and any amendment or supplement to such ruling request
          letter.</font></font></div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#8220;<u>IRS Settlement</u>&#8221; means the settlement with the IRS with respect to the tax years and matters described on <u>Exhibit A</u>.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#8220;<u>Joint Return</u>&#8221; shall mean any Tax Return that includes, by election or otherwise, one or more members of the Company Group together with one or more members of the SpinCo Group.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#8220;<u>Non-Controlling Party</u>&#8221; shall mean, with respect to a Tax Contest, the Party that is not entitled to control such Tax Contest pursuant to <u>Sections 6.2</u>, <u>6.3</u>, and <u>6.4</u> of
      this Agreement.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#8220;<u>Parties</u>&#8221; shall have the meaning set forth in the preamble hereto.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#8220;<u>Past Practices</u>&#8221; shall have the meaning set forth in <u>Section 3.5</u>.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#8220;<u>Pillar Two Provisions</u>&#8221; shall mean (i) the model rules published by the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (&#8220;<u>OECD</u>&#8221;) in respect of Pillar Two of the OECD&#8217;s BEPS 2.0
      project and any associated rules or guidance issued by the OECD (the &#8220;<u>GloBE Rules</u>&#8221;) and (ii) any Law of any jurisdiction which implements, or facilitates the implementation of, the GloBE Rules in that or any other jurisdiction.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#8220;<u>Pillar Two Taxes</u>&#8221; shall mean any Qualified Domestic Minimum Top-Up Tax and any Tax charged pursuant to the Income Inclusion Rule and the Undertaxed Profits Rule (in each case, as defined in
      the Pillar Two Provisions) with respect to any Pre-Distribution Period.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="clear: both; margin-top: 10pt; margin-bottom: 10pt;" class="BRPFPageBreakArea">
      <div style="text-align: center;" class="BRPFPageNumberArea"><font style="font-size: 8pt; color: #000000; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal;" class="BRPFPageNumber">5</font></div>
      <div style="page-break-after: always;" class="BRPFPageBreak">

    </div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#8220;<u>Post-Distribution Period</u>&#8221; shall mean any taxable period (or portion thereof) beginning after the Distribution Date, including for the avoidance of doubt, the portion of any Straddle Period
      beginning after the Distribution Date.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt; font-size: 12pt;"><font style="font-size: 10pt; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#8220;</font><font style="font-size: 10pt;"><u>Prepaid Transaction Tax Amounts</u>&#8221; shall mean any cash amounts held by any member of the SpinCo Group as of
        immediately after the Effective Time, which cash amounts are designated by the Company in its sole discretion for the payment of Transaction Taxes.</font></div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#8220;<u>Pre-Distribution Period</u>&#8221; shall mean any taxable period (or portion thereof) ending on or before the Distribution Date, including for the avoidance of doubt, the portion of any Straddle Period
      ending at the end of the day on the Distribution Date.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#8220;<u>Proposed Acquisition Transaction</u>&#8221; shall mean a transaction or series of transactions (or any agreement, understanding or arrangement, within the meaning of Section 355(e) of the Code and
      Treasury Regulations Section 1.355-7, or any other regulations promulgated thereunder, to enter into a transaction or series of transactions), whether such transaction is supported by SpinCo management or shareholders, is a hostile acquisition, or
      otherwise, as a result of which SpinCo would merge or consolidate with any other Person or as a result of which one or more Persons would (directly or indirectly) acquire, or have the right to acquire, from SpinCo and/or one or more holders of SpinCo
      Capital Stock, respectively, any amount or number of shares of SpinCo Capital Stock, that would, when combined with the retention of the Retained Shares by the Company and any other direct or indirect changes in ownership of SpinCo Capital Stock
      pertinent for purposes of Section 355(e) of the Code and/or the Treasury Regulations promulgated thereunder, comprise a Fifty-Percent or Greater Interest in SpinCo as of the date of such transaction, or in the case of a series of transactions, the
      date of the last transaction of such series. Notwithstanding the foregoing, a Proposed Acquisition Transaction shall not include (i) the adoption by SpinCo of a shareholder rights plan described in Revenue Ruling 90-11, 1990-1 C.B. 10, or (ii)
      issuances of SpinCo Capital Stock by SpinCo that satisfy Safe Harbor VIII (relating to acquisitions in connection with a person&#8217;s performance of services) or Safe Harbor IX (relating to acquisitions by a retirement plan of an employer), in each case,
      of Treasury Regulations Section 1.355-7(d). For purposes of determining whether a transaction constitutes an indirect acquisition, any recapitalization resulting in a shift of voting power or any redemption of shares of stock shall be treated as an
      indirect acquisition of shares of stock by the non-exchanging shareholders. This definition and the application thereof is intended to monitor compliance with Section 355(e) of the Code and the Treasury Regulations promulgated thereunder and shall be
      interpreted accordingly. Any clarification of, or change in, the statute or regulations promulgated under Section 355(e) of the Code shall be incorporated in this definition and its interpretation. For the avoidance of doubt, any references to SpinCo
      in this definition and related provisions of this Agreement shall include a reference to any successor thereto.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt; font-size: 12pt;"><font style="font-size: 10pt; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#8220;<u>Refund</u>&#8221; shall mean any refund (or credit in lieu thereof) of Taxes (including any overpayment of Taxes that can be refunded or, alternatively,
        applied against other Taxes payable), including any interest paid on or with respect to such refund of Taxes; </font><font style="font-size: 10pt;"><u>provided</u>, <u>however</u>, the amount of the refund of Taxes shall be net of any reasonable
        expenses incurred in obtaining such refund and any Taxes imposed by any Taxing Authority on the receipt of the refund<font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">.</font></font></div>

    </div>

    <div>&#160;</div>

      Distribution Date.</div>

      group&#8221; (as defined in Section 355(b)(3)(B) of the Code) of the SpinCo Business (as defined in the IRS Ruling Request and as further described in the Tax Materials) as conducted immediately prior to the Distribution.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>

      stock and (iii) all instruments properly treated as stock in SpinCo for U.S. federal income Tax purposes.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>

      taxable period to another prior taxable period under the Code or other applicable Tax Law.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#8220;<u>SpinCo Disqualifying Action</u>&#8221; shall mean (i) any action (or the failure to take any action) by any member of the SpinCo Group after the Distribution (including entering into any agreement,
      understanding or arrangement or any negotiations with respect to any transaction or series of transactions), (ii) any event (or series of events) after the Distribution involving the SpinCo Capital Stock or any stock or assets of SpinCo or any member
      of the SpinCo Group, or (iii) any breach by SpinCo or any member of the SpinCo Group after the Distribution of any representation, warranty or covenant made by it in this Agreement, the Separation Agreement, or any other Transaction Document, that,
      in each case, would adversely affect the Tax-Free Status&#894; <u>provided</u>, <u>however</u>, that the term &#8220;SpinCo Disqualifying Action&#8221; shall not include any action required pursuant to any Transaction Document (other than this Agreement) or that is
      specifically contemplated by the Separation or the Distribution.</div>

      profits, foreign tax credit carryovers, overall foreign losses, overall domestic losses, previously taxed earnings and profits, separate limitation losses and any other Tax Item that could affect a Tax.</div>

      other item reducing any Taxes otherwise payable, net of reasonable expenses related to establishing the Tax Benefit.</div>

      return, amended tax return, claim for refund or declaration of estimated tax) supplied to or filed with, or required to be supplied to or filed with, a Taxing Authority, including any amendment thereof or supplement thereto, or any bill for or notice

    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 72pt;">(a)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;with respect to the Contribution and the Distribution, taken together, and each Internal Distribution, the qualification thereof:</div>

      described in Sections 368(a)(1)(D) and 355(a) of the Code;</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 108pt;">(ii)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;in the case of the Internal Spin-Off (including the Internal Cash Distribution), as a &#8220;reorganization&#8221; described in Sections 368(a)(1)(D) and 355(a) of the Code;</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 108pt;">(iii)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; in the case of any Internal Distribution (other than the Internal Spin-Off), as a &#8220;reorganization&#8221; described in Sections 368(a)(1)(D) and 355(a) of the Code;</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 108pt;">(iv)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; in the case of each of clauses (i) and (iii), as a transaction in which cash or other property received is property with respect to which no gain or loss is recognized pursuant to Section 361(a) or (b) of
      the Code;</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 108pt;">(v)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;in the case of clause (ii) with respect to the Internal Spin-Off, as a transaction in which cash or other property received is property with respect to which no gain or loss is recognized pursuant to
      Section 361(a) or (b) of the Code, except to the extent the amount of the Internal Cash Distribution (and any such other cash received by the Company in respect of the Internal Cash Distribution) exceeds KBR Holdings&#8217;s adjusted tax basis in the
      assets transferred to Internal SpinCo pursuant to the Internal Contribution and assuming the Company transfers to creditors or distributes to shareholders the cash received in respect of the Internal Cash Distribution and any such other cash received
      by the Company in pursuance of the plan of reorganization within the meaning of Section 361(b)(1) of the Code;</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 108pt;">(vi)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; in the case of each of clauses (i) through (iii), stock distributed (or deemed distributed) thereby (including, in the case of clause (i), any Retained Shares that may be distributed to creditors or
      shareholders of the Company in connection with the plan of &#8220;reorganization&#8221;) is &#8220;qualified property&#8221; with respect to which no gain or loss is recognized pursuant to Section 361(c) or Section 355(c)(2) of the Code, as applicable (and neither Section
      355(d) nor Section 355(e) applies to treat such property as other than &#8220;qualified property&#8221; for such purposes); and</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 108pt;">(vii)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; in the case of each of clauses (i) through (iii), as a transaction in which no income or gain is recognized by (A) any member of the Company Group (except as otherwise provided in clause (v)), (B) any
      member of the SpinCo Group or (C) the holders of Company Common Stock (except to the extent holders of Company Common Stock receive cash in lieu of fractional shares), pursuant to Sections 355, 361 and/or 1032 of the Code, other than, in the case of
      the Company, SpinCo and the members of their respective Groups (as relevant), any income or gain recognized as a result of intercompany items or excess loss accounts taken into account pursuant to the Treasury Regulations promulgated pursuant to
      Section 1502 of the Code.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#8220;<u>Tax-Related Losses</u>&#8221; shall mean with respect to any Taxes (or any reduction in a Refund), (i) all reasonable accounting, legal and other professional fees, and court costs incurred in
      connection with such Taxes (or reduction in a Refund); and (ii) all damages and reasonable costs and expenses associated with stockholder litigation or controversies and any amount paid by the Company (or any of its Affiliates) or SpinCo (or any of
      its Affiliates) in respect of the liability of shareholders, whether paid to shareholders or to the IRS or any other Taxing Authority, in the case of this clause (ii), resulting from the failure of the Transactions to qualify for the Tax-Free Status.</div>

      assessment, determination, collection or imposition of any Tax (including the IRS).</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt; font-size: 12pt;"><font style="font-size: 10pt; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#8220;<u>Transaction Document</u>&#8221; means this Agreement, the Separation Agreement, the Employee Matters Agreement, the Continuing Arrangements MSAs,</font><font style="font-size: 10pt;">&#160;<font style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">the Stockholder and Registration Rights Agreement, and the Transition Services Agreement, and including all annexes, Exhibits, Schedules, attachments and appendices thereto, and any
          certificate or other instrument delivered by any Party to any other Party pursuant to this Agreement or any of the foregoing.</font></font></div>

      regardless of whether such Taxes are paid prior to, as of, or following the Distribution Time.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>

      to the Transactions.</div>

    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#8220;<u>Treasury Regulations</u>&#8221; shall mean the regulations promulgated from time to time under the Code as in effect for the relevant Tax period.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#8220;<u>Unqualified Tax Opinion</u>&#8221; shall mean a &#8220;will&#8221; opinion, without substantive qualifications, of a Tax Advisor, which Tax Advisor is acceptable to the Company in its reasonable discretion, on
      which the Company may rely to the effect that a transaction will not (i) affect the Tax-Free Status or (ii) adversely affect any of the conclusions set forth in any Tax Opinion or the IRS Ruling regarding the Tax-Free Status; <u>provided</u>, that
      any such tax opinion obtained in connection with a proposed acquisition of SpinCo Capital Stock or the Capital Stock of a SpinCo Section 355 Affiliate entered into during the Restricted Period shall not qualify as an Unqualified Tax Opinion unless
      such tax opinion concludes that such proposed acquisition will not be treated as &#8220;part of a plan (or series of related transactions),&#8221; within the meaning of Section 355(e) of the Code and the Treasury Regulations promulgated thereunder, that includes
      the Distribution or any Internal Distribution. Any such tax opinion must assume that the Contribution and Distribution and each Internal Distribution would have qualified for the Tax-Free Status if the transaction in question did not occur.</div>

    <div style="text-align: center; font-weight: bold;"><a name="z_Toc225759003"></a>ARTICLE II</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-align: center; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-weight: bold;"><a name="z_Toc225759078"></a><a name="z_Toc239862216"></a><a name="z_Toc225759153"></a>PAYMENTS AND TAX REFUNDS</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt;"><a name="z_Toc225759004"></a><a name="z_Toc239862217"></a><a name="z_Toc225759154"></a><a name="z_Toc225759079"></a>2.1&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;<u>U.S. Federal Taxes Relating to Joint Returns</u>.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="clear: both; margin-top: 10pt; margin-bottom: 10pt;" class="BRPFPageBreakArea">
      <div style="text-align: center;" class="BRPFPageNumberArea"><font style="font-size: 8pt; color: #000000; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal;" class="BRPFPageNumber">11</font></div>
      <div style="page-break-after: always;" class="BRPFPageBreak">
        <hr style="border-width: 0px; clear: both; margin: 4px 0px; width: 100%; height: 2px; color: #000000; background-color: #000000;" noshade="noshade"></div>
    </div>
    <div style="text-indent: 72pt;">(a)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;The Company shall pay and be responsible for any and all Federal Taxes due with respect to or required to be reported on any Joint Return for all Pre-Distribution Periods.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 72pt;">(b)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;SpinCo shall pay and be responsible for any and all Federal Taxes due with respect to or required to be reported on any Joint Return which are attributable to the SpinCo Business for all Post-Distribution
      Periods.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 72pt;">(c)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;The Company shall pay and be responsible for any and all Federal Taxes due with respect to or required to be reported on any Joint Return for all Post-Distribution Periods, other than any Federal Taxes
      described in <u>Section 2.1(b)</u>.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt;"><a name="z_Toc239862218"></a>2.2&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;<u>U.S. Federal Taxes Relating to Separate Returns</u>.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 72pt;">(a)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;The Company shall pay and be responsible for any and all Federal Taxes due with respect to or required to be reported on any Company Separate Return for all Tax periods.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 72pt;">(b)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;SpinCo shall pay and be responsible for any and all Federal Taxes due with respect to or required to be reported on any SpinCo Separate Return for all Tax periods.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt;"><a name="z_Toc239862219"></a>2.3&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;<u>U.S. State Taxes Relating to Joint Returns</u>.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 72pt;">(a)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;The Company shall pay and be responsible for any and all State Taxes due with respect to or required to be reported on any Joint Return for all Pre-Distribution Periods, other than any State Taxes
      historically identified as billable to SpinCo Group customers, as determined by the Company in its sole discretion consistent with Past Practices (such Taxes for any Tax period, &#8220;<u>SpinCo State Taxes</u>&#8221;).</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 72pt;">(b)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;SpinCo shall pay and be responsible for any and all State Taxes due with respect to or required to be reported on any Joint Return which Taxes (i) are attributable to the SpinCo Business for all
      Post-Distribution Periods or (ii) are SpinCo State Taxes.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 72pt;">(c)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;The Company shall pay and be responsible for any and all State Taxes due with respect to or required to be reported on any Joint Return for all Post-Distribution Periods, other than any State Taxes described
      in <u>Section 2.3(b)</u>.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt;"><a name="z_Toc239862220"></a>2.4&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;<u>U.S. State Taxes Relating to Separate Returns</u>.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 72pt;">(a)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;The Company shall pay and be responsible for any and all State Taxes due with respect to or required to be reported on any Company Separate Return for all Tax periods.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 72pt;">(b)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;SpinCo shall pay and be responsible for any and all State Taxes due with respect to or required to be reported on any SpinCo Separate Return for all Tax periods.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="clear: both; margin-top: 10pt; margin-bottom: 10pt;" class="BRPFPageBreakArea">
      <div style="text-align: center;" class="BRPFPageNumberArea"><font style="font-size: 8pt; color: #000000; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal;" class="BRPFPageNumber">12</font></div>
      <div style="page-break-after: always;" class="BRPFPageBreak">
        <hr style="border-width: 0px; clear: both; margin: 4px 0px; width: 100%; height: 2px; color: #000000; background-color: #000000;" noshade="noshade"></div>
    </div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt;"><a name="z_Toc239862221"></a>2.5&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;<u>Foreign Taxes Relating to Joint Returns</u>.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 72pt;">(a)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;The Company shall pay and be responsible for any and all Foreign Taxes due with respect to or required to be reported on any Joint Return for all Pre-Distribution Periods.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 72pt;">(b)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;SpinCo shall pay and be responsible for any and all Foreign Taxes due with respect to or required to be reported on any Joint Return which Taxes are attributable to the SpinCo Business for all
      Post-Distribution Periods.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 72pt;">(c)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;The Company shall pay and be responsible for any and all Foreign Taxes due with respect to or required to be reported on any Joint Return for all Post-Distribution Periods, other than any Foreign Taxes
      described in <u>Section 2.5(b)</u>.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt;"><a name="z_Toc239862222"></a>2.6&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;<u>Foreign Taxes Relating to Separate Returns</u>.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 72pt;">(a)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;The Company shall pay and be responsible for any and all Foreign Taxes due with respect to or required to be reported on any Company Separate Return for all Tax periods.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 72pt;">(b)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;SpinCo shall pay and be responsible for any and all Foreign Taxes due with respect to or required to be reported on any SpinCo Separate Return for all Tax periods.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt;"><a name="z_Toc239862223"></a>2.7&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;<u>Pillar Two Taxes</u>.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 72pt;">(a)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;The Company shall be responsible for any and all Pillar Two Taxes due with respect to or required to be reported on any Tax Return which are attributable (determined on a &#8220;with and without basis&#8221;) to the
      Parent Retained Business, assets used primarily in the Parent Retained Business or the business or activities of any member of the Company Group, as determined by the Company in its sole discretion consistent with Past Practices (if any).</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 72pt;">(b)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;SpinCo shall be responsible for any and all Pillar Two Taxes due with respect to or required to be reported on any Tax Return which are attributable (determined on a &#8220;with and without basis&#8221;) to the SpinCo
      Business, assets used primarily in the SpinCo Business or the business or activities of any member of the SpinCo Group, as determined by the Company in its sole discretion consistent with Past Practices (if any).</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 72pt;">(c)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;Notwithstanding the provisions set forth in <u>Sections 2.7(a)</u> and <u>2.7(b)</u>, with respect to any Pillar Two Tax which the Company, acting reasonably and consistently with Past Practices (if any),
      is unable to attribute to either the Company or SpinCo under <u>Section 2.7(a)</u> or <u>Section 2.7(b)</u>, the Company and SpinCo shall each pay and be responsible for fifty percent (50%) of any such Pillar Two Taxes.</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 72pt;"> <br>
    </div>
    <div style="text-indent: 72pt;">(d)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; Exhibit D sets forth the Parties&#8217; good-faith estimate of the Pillar Two Taxes allocable to each of the Company and SpinCo pursuant to this Section 2.7 for the Tax period ending on the Distribution Date. </div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt;"><a name="z_Toc225759155"></a><a name="z_Toc239862224"></a><a name="z_Toc225759005"></a><a name="z_Toc225759080"></a>2.8&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;<u>Deferred Assets; Deferred Liabilities</u>. The Parties acknowledge and agree that,
      notwithstanding anything contained herein to the contrary, this Agreement shall not in any way affect or modify the Parties&#8217; rights and obligations under Section 2.5 of the Separation Agreement.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="clear: both; margin-top: 10pt; margin-bottom: 10pt;" class="BRPFPageBreakArea">
      <div style="text-align: center;" class="BRPFPageNumberArea"><font style="font-size: 8pt; color: #000000; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal;" class="BRPFPageNumber">13</font></div>
      <div style="page-break-after: always;" class="BRPFPageBreak">
        <hr style="border-width: 0px; clear: both; margin: 4px 0px; width: 100%; height: 2px; color: #000000; background-color: #000000;" noshade="noshade"></div>
    </div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt;"><a name="z_Toc225759006"></a><a name="z_Toc225759156"></a><a name="z_Toc239862225"></a><a name="z_Toc225759081"></a>2.9&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;<u>Transaction Taxes</u>.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 72pt;">(a)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;Notwithstanding the provisions set forth in <u>Sections 2.1</u>, <u>2.2</u>, <u>2.3</u>, <u>2.4</u>, <u>2.5</u>, <u>2.6</u> and <u>2.7</u>, the Company shall be responsible for one-hundred percent
      (100%) of any Transaction Taxes, as reasonably determined by the Company.&#160; The Parties shall cooperate to minimize any Transaction Taxes and to obtain any credit, Refund, or rebate of Transaction Taxes, or to apply for an exemption or zero-rating for
      goods or services giving rise to any Transaction Taxes, including by filing any exemption or other similar forms or providing valid tax identification numbers or other relevant registration numbers, certificates, or other documents or by obtaining
      any rulings from the applicable Taxing Authorities.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 72pt;">(b)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;Payments pursuant to <u>Section 2.9(a)</u> shall be determined and made in accordance with the following principles and in the following manner:</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 108pt;">(i)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; &#160; &#160;&#160; Any and all Transaction Taxes that were paid at or prior to the Distribution, regardless of whether paid by a member of the Company Group or a member of the SpinCo Group, shall be deemed for all purposes
      of this Agreement to have been paid by the Company.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 108pt;">(ii)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;With respect to any Transaction Taxes allocated to the Company pursuant to <u>Section 2.9(a)</u> in respect of which, absent the application of this <u>Section 2.9(b)(ii)</u>, the Company would be
      required to make a payment to SpinCo pursuant to <u>Section 2.9(a)</u> (a &#8220;<u>Company Transaction Tax Required Payment</u>&#8221;), any Prepaid Transaction Tax Amounts allocable to such Transaction Taxes (as designated by the Company in its sole
      discretion) shall, for purposes of this <u>Section 2.9</u>, be treated as a payment made by the Company to SpinCo in respect of such Transaction Taxes in full or partial satisfaction (or overpayment), as applicable, of the Company Transaction Tax
      Required Payment with respect thereto, and the provisions of this <u>Section 2.9</u> shall be applied accordingly. Without limiting the generality of the foregoing provisions of this clause (ii) and in furtherance and illustration of the principles
      set forth therein:</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 144pt;">(1)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;any Company Transaction Tax Required Payment otherwise required with respect to any Transaction Taxes shall be reduced, but not below zero, by the amount of any Prepaid Transaction Tax Amounts (A) allocable
      to such Transaction Taxes (as designated by the Company in its sole discretion) and (B) not (x) previously taken into account pursuant to this clause (1) to reduce the amount of any Company Transaction Tax Required Payment or (y) repaid by SpinCo to
      the Company pursuant to clause (2) below; and</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 144pt;">(2)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;if the amount of such Prepaid Transaction Tax Amounts exceeds the amount of the Company Transaction Tax Required Payment with respect to such Transaction Taxes, SpinCo shall pay such excess to the Company;
      <font style="font-style: italic;">provided</font>, that the timing of any payment (or portion thereof) required to be made by SpinCo pursuant to this clause (2) shall be determined by the Company in its sole discretion and SpinCo shall make all
      payments pursuant to this clause (2) in accordance with the payments dates determined by the Company.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 108pt;">(iii)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;Notwithstanding anything herein to the contrary, the Company may determine in its sole discretion that any payment required to be made by the Company or SpinCo pursuant to this <u>Section 2.9</u> shall
      be delayed until such date as the Company shall determine (a &#8220;<u>Settlement Date</u>&#8221;) and, on the Settlement Date, all outstanding amounts then owing by the Company and SpinCo (taking into account all Prepaid Transaction Tax Amounts not previously
      applied or repaid pursuant to <u>Section 2.9(b)(ii)</u>) pursuant to this <u>Section 2.9</u> shall be netted, such that only one payment shall be made by the Company or SpinCo, as applicable, in full settlement of all such outstanding amounts.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="clear: both; margin-top: 10pt; margin-bottom: 10pt;" class="BRPFPageBreakArea">
      <div style="text-align: center;" class="BRPFPageNumberArea"><font style="font-size: 8pt; color: #000000; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal;" class="BRPFPageNumber">14</font></div>
      <div style="page-break-after: always;" class="BRPFPageBreak">
        <hr style="border-width: 0px; clear: both; margin: 4px 0px; width: 100%; height: 2px; color: #000000; background-color: #000000;" noshade="noshade"></div>
    </div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt;"><a name="z_Toc239862226"></a>2.10&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; <u>Determination of Tax Attributable to the SpinCo Business</u>. For purposes of this <u>Article II</u> (except as expressly provided otherwise therein):</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 72pt;">(a)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;The amount of Federal Taxes attributable to the SpinCo Business shall be as reasonably determined by the Company on a pro forma SpinCo Group consolidated return prepared:</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 108pt;">(i)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; &#160; &#160;&#160; including only Tax Items of members of the SpinCo Group that were included in the relevant Company Consolidated Tax Return;</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 108pt;">(ii)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;except as provided in <u>Section 2.10(a)(iv)</u>, using all elections, accounting methods and conventions used on the relevant Company Consolidated Tax Return for such period;</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 108pt;">(iii)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; applying the highest statutory marginal corporate income Tax rate in effect for such taxable period;</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 108pt;">(iv)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; assuming that the SpinCo Group elects not to carry back any net operating losses.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 72pt;">(b)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;The amount of State Taxes and Foreign Taxes attributable to the SpinCo Business shall be as reasonably determined by the Company in a manner consistent with the principles of <u>Section 2.10(a)</u>, to the
      extent relevant or as reasonably determined by the Company in a manner consistent with Past Practices (if any).</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt;"><a name="z_Toc225759157"></a><a name="z_Toc239862227"></a><a name="z_Toc225759007"></a><a name="z_Toc225759082"></a>2.11&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; <u>Certain Indemnified Taxes; Integration; Satisfaction</u>.&#160; For the avoidance of doubt,
      notwithstanding the provisions set forth in this <u>Article II</u>, nothing in this <u>Article II</u> shall be interpreted as limiting in any way the Parties&#8217; indemnification obligations pursuant to <u>Section 5.1(a)(ii)</u> or <u>Sections
        5.1(b)(ii)</u> through <u>(b)(v)</u> (the &#8220;<u>Specific Indemnities</u>&#8221;), and, in the case of any conflict between the allocation of liability for Taxes set forth in this <u>Article II</u> and the Specific Indemnities, the Specific Indemnities
      shall govern (and the conflicting liability allocations set forth in this <u>Article II</u> shall not apply). Without prejudice or limitation to any of the indemnification or liability allocation provisions contained in this Agreement, the Parties
      acknowledge and agree that, on the basis of all facts and circumstances as of the date hereof and through the Effective Time, SpinCo shall, and is expected to, satisfy any liability or other obligation (or portion thereof) it assumes pursuant to this
      Agreement, whether or not the Company has been legally relieved of such liability.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt;"><a name="z_Toc225759158"></a><a name="z_Toc239862228"></a><a name="z_Toc225759008"></a><a name="z_Toc225759083"></a>2.12&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; <u>Allocation of Employment Taxes</u>.&#160; Liability for Employment Taxes shall be determined
      pursuant to the Employee Matters Agreement.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="clear: both; margin-top: 10pt; margin-bottom: 10pt;" class="BRPFPageBreakArea">
      <div style="text-align: center;" class="BRPFPageNumberArea"><font style="font-size: 8pt; color: #000000; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal;" class="BRPFPageNumber">15</font></div>
      <div style="page-break-after: always;" class="BRPFPageBreak">
        <hr style="border-width: 0px; clear: both; margin: 4px 0px; width: 100%; height: 2px; color: #000000; background-color: #000000;" noshade="noshade"></div>
    </div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt;"><a name="z_Toc225759009"></a><a name="z_Toc239862229"></a><a name="z_Toc225759159"></a><a name="z_Toc225759084"></a>2.13&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; <u>Tax Refunds</u>.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 72pt;">(a)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;Subject to <u>Section 2.12</u>, <u>Section 2.13(b)</u>, <u>Section 2.14</u> and <u>Section 2.15</u>, the Company (or any of its Affiliates) shall be entitled to all Refunds related to Taxes for which it
      (or any of its Affiliates) is liable pursuant to this Agreement or for which it has previously paid and SpinCo (or any of its Affiliates) shall be entitled to all Refunds related to Taxes for which it (or any of its Affiliates) is liable pursuant to
      this Agreement or for which it has previously paid. For the avoidance of doubt, the Company shall be entitled to any and all Refunds attributable to the IRS Settlement.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 72pt;">(b)&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;SpinCo shall pay to the Company any Refund received or deemed to have been received by SpinCo or any member of the SpinCo Group that the Company is entitled to pursuant to <u>Section 2.13(a)</u>, net of any
      reasonable costs and expenses incurred in connection with, and any Taxes imposed by any Taxing Authority on, related to, or attributable to, the receipt, accrual or realization of such Refund (including any Taxes imposed by way of withholding or
      offset), in immediately available funds in accordance with <u>Article V</u>. The Company shall pay to SpinCo any Refund received by the Company or any member of the Company Group that SpinCo is entitled to pursuant to <u>Section 2.13(a)</u>, net of
      any costs and expenses incurred in connection with, and any Taxes imposed by any Taxing Authority on, related to, or attributable to, the receipt, accrual or realization of such Refund (including any Taxes imposed by way of withholding or offset), in
      immediately available funds in accordance with <u>Article V</u>. For purposes of this <u>Section 2.13(b)</u>, any overpayment of Taxes that is applied as a credit toward or a reduction in Taxes otherwise payable (or a Taxing Authority requires such
      application in lieu of a Refund), and such Refund, if received, would have been payable to the Company or SpinCo, as applicable, pursuant to this <u>Section 2.13</u>, shall be deemed to have actually been received by SpinCo or any member of the
      SpinCo Group, or by the Company or any member of the Company Group, as applicable, as a Refund to the extent thereof on the date on which the overpayment is applied to reduce Taxes otherwise payable.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt;"><a name="z_Toc225759160"></a><a name="z_Toc239862230"></a><a name="z_Toc225759010"></a><a name="z_Toc225759085"></a>2.14&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; <u>Tax Benefits</u>.&#160; Without prejudice to (or duplication of any amounts payable pursuant
      to) <u>Section 2.15</u>, if the Company determines, in its reasonable discretion, that: (a) one Party is liable for an Adjustment pursuant to this Agreement or under applicable Law and (b) the other Party is entitled to a Tax Benefit relating to
      such Adjustment, then the Party entitled to such Tax Benefit shall pay to the Party liable for such Adjustment the amount of the Tax Benefit within one hundred twenty (120) Business Days following the realization of the Tax Benefit, net of any costs
      and expenses incurred in connection with, and any Taxes imposed by any Taxing Authority on, related to, or attributable to, the receipt, accrual or realization of such Tax Benefit (including any Taxes imposed by way of withholding or offset), in each
      case, as determined by the Company in its reasonable discretion. For the avoidance of doubt, if such Tax Benefit results in the reduction of an indemnity payment pursuant to <u>Section 5.2(c)</u>, no payment shall be required under this <u>Section
        2.14</u> to the extent the paying Party reduced its Tax indemnity payment under <u>Section 5.2(c)</u>.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="clear: both; margin-top: 10pt; margin-bottom: 10pt;" class="BRPFPageBreakArea">
      <div style="text-align: center;" class="BRPFPageNumberArea"><font style="font-size: 8pt; color: #000000; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal;" class="BRPFPageNumber">16</font></div>

    </div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt;"><a name="z_Toc225759161"></a><a name="z_Toc239862231"></a><a name="z_Toc225759011"></a><a name="z_Toc225759086"></a>2.15&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; <u>Carryback Refunds and Benefits</u>.&#160; Notwithstanding anything herein to the contrary
      (and without duplication of any other amounts payable pursuant to this Agreement), but subject to the other provisions of this <u>Section 2.15</u>, in the event of any carry back of any SpinCo Carryback arising in a Post-Distribution Period to a
      Pre-Distribution Period that is permitted by <u>Section 3.8</u>, SpinCo shall be entitled to any Refund or other Tax Benefit actually realized by any member of the Company Group in cash that is attributable to, and would not have arisen but for,
      such SpinCo carryback. The Company shall pay to SpinCo the amount of any such Refund or other Tax Benefit, net of any costs, expenses or Taxes imposed by any Taxing Authority on, related to, or attributable to, the receipt, accrual or realization of
      such Refund or Tax Benefit, no later than five (5) Business Days after the receipt of such Refund or other Tax Benefit (the timing of the receipt of which shall be determined in accordance with the principles of <u>Section 2.13(b)</u>).
      Notwithstanding anything in this Agreement to the contrary, SpinCo shall indemnify and hold the members of the Company Group harmless from and against any and all collateral Tax consequences resulting from or caused by any such SpinCo Carryback,
      including (but not limited to) the loss or postponement of any benefit from the use of Tax Attributes generated by a member of the Company Group or an Affiliate thereof if (a) such Tax Attributes expire unutilized, but would have been utilized but
      for such SpinCo Carryback, or (b) the use of such Tax Attributes is postponed to a later taxable period than the taxable period in which such Tax Attributes would have been utilized but for such SpinCo Carryback.&#160; Any payment made by the Company to
      SpinCo pursuant to this <u>Section 2.15</u> shall be recalculated in light of any Final Determination (or any other facts that may arise or come to light after such payment is made, such as a carryback of a Tax Attribute of the Company Group to a
      taxable period in respect of which such Refund is or was received or Tax Benefit is or was realized) that would affect the amount to which SpinCo is entitled, and an appropriate adjusting payment shall be made by SpinCo to the Company such that the
      aggregate amount paid pursuant to this <u>Section 2.15</u> equals such recalculated amount.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt;"><a name="z_Toc225759162"></a><a name="z_Toc239862232"></a><a name="z_Toc225759012"></a><a name="z_Toc225759087"></a>2.16&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; <u>Tax Adjustments</u>.&#160; If the Company or SpinCo (or one of their respective Affiliates)
      pays to the other Party any amount pursuant to <u>Section 2.12</u>, <u>Section 2.13</u>, <u>Section 2.14</u> or<u> Section 2.15</u>, in respect of a Refund or Tax Benefit and all or a portion of such Refund or Tax Benefit is subsequently
      disallowed or adjusted by a Taxing Authority or in a Tax Contest, such disallowance or adjustment shall be allocated to the Company Group and the SpinCo Group in the same manner in which such Refund or Tax Benefit was allocated pursuant to <u>Section


        2.12</u>, <u>Section 2.13</u>, <u>Section 2.14</u>, or <u>Section 2.15</u>, as applicable, and an appropriate adjusting payment shall be promptly made (including in respect of any interest paid or imposed by any Taxing Authority) to reflect such
      disallowance or adjustment.</div>
    <div>&#160;</div>
    <div style="text-indent: 36pt;"><a name="z_Toc225759163"></a><a name="z_Toc239862233"></a><a name="z_Toc225759013"></a><a name="z_Toc225759088"></a>2.17&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; <u>Prior Agreements</u>.&#160; Except as set forth in this Agreement and in consideration of the
      mutual indemnities and other obligations of this Agreement, any and all prior Tax sharing or allocation agreements, arrangements or practices between any member of the Company Group and any member of the SpinCo Group shall be terminated with respect
      to the SpinCo Group and the Company Group as of the Distribution Date. No member of either the SpinCo Group or the Company Group shall have any continuing rights or obligations under any such agreement, arrangement or practice.</div>
